timeline.text: A lesson card used to get checked only after it was fully built -- so one mistake meant redoing the whole batch.
That wasted model calls and left a parent waiting longer, for nothing new.
Now the builder runs that very same check on its own work, before it calls itself done.
Claude catches its own mistake and fixes it on the spot.
No more starting over -- the error gets caught and corrected in the very pass that made it.
